import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionSupport
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionHomotopy

/-!
# Small-chain subdivision operators

The simplex-wise factorisations of subdivision and its homotopy assemble into
maps on the small singular chain complex.  These maps are characterized by
their compatibility with the canonical inclusion into all singular chains.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {n : ℕ}

/-- Subdivision lifted to the small singular chain complex. -/
def smallSingularSubdivisionMap {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n :=
  Sigma.desc fun σ =>
    Classical.choose (singularSimplexChain_subdivision_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2)

/-- The lifted subdivision agrees with subdivision after inclusion. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem smallSingularSubdivisionMap_inclusion {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    smallSingularSubdivisionMap U n ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n =
      (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫
        singularSubdivision X n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  have h : (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.ιChainComplex σ ≫
      smallSingularSubdivisionMap U n =
        Classical.choose (singularSimplexChain_subdivision_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2) :=
    Sigma.ι_desc _ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, h, smallSingularChainInclusion_simplex_assoc]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (singularSimplexChain_subdivision_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2)

/-- The homotopy operator lifted to the small singular chain complex. -/
def smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X (n + 1) :=
  Sigma.desc fun σ =>
    Classical.choose (singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2)

/-- The lifted homotopy agrees with the singular homotopy after inclusion. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_inclusion {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    (n : ℕ) :
    smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap U n ≫
        (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) =
      (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫
        singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro σ
  have h : (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.ιChainComplex σ ≫
      smallSingularSubdivisionHomotopyMap U n =
        Classical.choose (singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2) :=
    Sigma.ι_desc _ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, h, smallSingularChainInclusion_simplex_assoc]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (singularSimplexChain_subdivisionHomotopy_small_factor U σ.1 σ.2)

/-- A cochain killed by the target inclusion is also killed after applying a
small-chain operator which intertwines with that inclusion. -/
theorem small_operator_comp_cochain_eq_zero
    {ι : Type*} {m : ℕ} (U : ι → Set X)
    (A : (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X m)
    (T : (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n ⟶
      (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X m)
    (hA : A ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f m =
      (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫ T)
    (φ : (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X m ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
    (hφ : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f m ≫ φ = 0) :
    (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n ≫ T ≫ φ = 0 := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← hA, Category.assoc, hφ, comp_zero]

end Mumford.Analytic
